A '''plaza''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gobindi]]. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], teenager [[Tash Arranda/Legends|Tash Arranda]], and the droid [[DV-9]] stopped in this plaza to talk, but Antilles had to slip away after [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] moved in to arrest [[Unidentified Rodian Rebel|another Rebel]].
